"""Controller for the RoboPaint limited-mode episode. All paper coordinates are world metres."""
import sys, math, json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])  # nib edge points along world -y
PAPER_Z = 0.020
INK = np.array([-0.100, 0.155, 0.009])


def pose(x,y,z,q=Q_DOWN): return np.r_[np.array([x,y,z],float), np.asarray(q,float)]

def move_rows(r, points, dt=0.5, note='move'):
    a=np.asarray(points,dtype=np.float32)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=dt,video='none',note=note)
    print(note, 'rows',len(a),'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'))
    return res

def paper_pix(u,v,z=PAPER_Z):
    # practice_cam projection, calibrated in spec; camera centre (-.1,-.1856,.47)
    f=1834.508057; d=.47-z
    x=-.100-(v-512)*d/f
    y=-.1856-(u-256)*d/f
    return x,y

def sampled_line(a,b,step_m=.0015):
    a=np.asarray(a); b=np.asarray(b); n=max(2,int(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step_m)+1)
    return np.array([a+(b-a)*i/(n-1) for i in range(n)])

def main():
    r=Robot(); print('status',r.status())
    o=r.get_obs(video='none'); now=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float); print('start tip',now)
    # Move from raised inspection pose to the ink well without passing low over either sheet.
    pts=[pose(0.00,.045,.44), pose(-.035,.105,.35), pose(-.070,.145,.25), pose(-.095,.155,.16), pose(-.100,.155,.08), pose(-.100,.155,.035), pose(*INK), pose(*INK), pose(*INK)]
    res=move_rows(r,pts,dt=.5,note='approach and load ink')
    # Retract, then return to practice sheet at a safe height.
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(-.100,.155,.10),pose(-.075,.075,.22),pose(-.050,-.030,.30),pose(-.060,-.100,.25),pose(-.075,-.155,.16)],dt=.5,note='move above practice')
    # A broad vertical mark and a fine horizontal mark establish the two nib axes.
    c=(150,400); a=paper_pix(*c); b=paper_pix(150,610)
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(a[0],a[1],.05),pose(a[0],a[1],PAPER_Z-.001)],dt=.3,note='lower to practice')
    line=sampled_line(np.array([*a,PAPER_Z-.001]),np.array([*b,PAPER_Z-.001]),.0015)
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(*v) for v in line],dt=.05,note='practice broad line')
    end=b
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(*end,.06), pose(*end,.12)],dt=.2,note='lift practice')
    # Return to a separate area for the along-edge fine line.
    c0=paper_pix(170,700); c1=paper_pix(350,700)
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(c0[0],c0[1],.10),pose(c0[0],c0[1],.05),pose(c0[0],c0[1],PAPER_Z-.001)],dt=.5,note='lower fine line')
    line=sampled_line(np.array([*c0,PAPER_Z-.001]),np.array([*c1,PAPER_Z-.001]),.0015)
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(*v) for v in line],dt=.05,note='practice fine line')
    res=move_rows(r,[pose(c1[0],c1[1],.08),pose(c1[0],c1[1],.18)],dt=.2,note='lift fine line')
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True,video='none'); o.save('/app/output/practice_cal')
    print('end status',r.status())

if __name__=='__main__': main()

The target image is sampled in its specified sheet millimetre coordinates. The

import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

MM_PER_PX = 0.00022186
SHEET = 0.227185
PAPER_Z = 0.019

WIDE_YAW = math.radians(45.0)

def target_xy(u, v):
    """Target pixel centre -> world x,y on the main sheet."""
    X=(u+0.5)*MM_PER_PX
    Y=(v+0.5)*MM_PER_PX
    return np.array([-0.100 + SHEET/2 - Y, SHEET/2 - X], dtype=float)


def q_yaw(yaw):
    """Rotate the downward pen around world vertical; edge lies along tool y."""
    return np.array([0.0, math.cos(yaw/2), math.sin(yaw/2), 0.0], dtype=float)


def nearest_edge_angle(angle, reference):
    # The nib edge is unchanged by a half turn, so use the nearby representative.
    while angle-reference > math.pi/2: angle -= math.pi
    while angle-reference < -math.pi/2: angle += math.pi
    return angle


def route_segment(a, b, style, previous_yaw):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); b=np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
    dv=b-a; pxlen=float(np.linalg.norm(dv))
    mm_len=pxlen*MM_PER_PX*1000.0
    n=max(2, int(math.ceil(mm_len/SAMPLE_MM))+1)
    phi=math.atan2(dv[1],dv[0])
    if style == 'wide':

    elif style == 'accent':

        wanted=nearest_edge_angle(-phi + math.radians(15.0), previous_yaw)

def move_rows(r, rows, dt=0.5, note='transit'):

    path=build_stroke(segments)
    start=path[0]; end=path[-1]
    q0=start[3:]

    move_rows(r,[pose_at(end[:2],0.080,end[3:])],dt=.2,note=name+' lift')

        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
        obs.save('/app/output/main_m1_check')
    return res


def save_final(r):
    to_safe(r)
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
    obs.save('/app/output/main_final')
    print('final status',json.dumps(r.status()))
    print('time_left_s',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--first',action='store_true',help='draw first m and inspect; this is the first main contact')
    ap.add_argument('--rest',action='store_true',help='draw the six remaining connected components')

    raise SystemExit('Use --first, then inspect, then --rest.')
